fan_use_policy.geometry: White paper, white jade guards/ribs, tiny silver pivot; no fan-mounted string, chain or tassel.
fan_use_policy.other_views: Identity, costume, pose and palette only. Small ambiguous fist-side pendants/lines in some pose or concept views must not define fan construction.
fan_use_policy.first_frame_rule: Use the two clear prop/detail masters for fan construction; reject a first frame that adds fan-mounted ornaments.
